suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require established knee/hip/hand OA in the source-relevant older-adult phenotype before incident sleep apnea; separately diagnose sleep apnea. Population cohort in adults age 50+; association does not establish causation and obesity/pain/activity limits may confound. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
